method.fruit_mask: Otsu threshold of 800 nm + fill holes + closing 15px + largest component; erosion 15px
method.pixel_classifier: Bayes, equal priors, histograms 64 bins/band; sound pixels = eroded fruit of Healthy-tissue fruits, defect pixels = SBW_Defect masks inside the eroded fruit; train folds only
method.features: mean/median/std of each band on sound and on defect tissue + defect ratio + n regions (>= 10px) + largest region / fruit area
method.cross_fitting: LDA training features of a train-fold fruit come from histograms that exclude the outer test fold AND the fruit's own fold (out-of-sample, like the test fruits)
method.folds: StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle, seed 42) = fold_assignment.json; deterministic, no seed dependence

settings.A_paper: LDA trained on sound (Healthy) + defective fruits only (paper: 280 + 246; stem/calyx recognised by a separate template matcher that is NOT replicated); applied to all test fruits
settings.B_all: LDA trained on all fruits, stem/calyx counted as sound (same task as the CNN, no stem/calyx detector)
